description: Get canonical FINN URLs for a brand and its models — for building internal linking blocks on SEO pages. For each model returns three URLs that target DIFFERENT funnels: `mdp_url` (marketing/brand page), `plp_subscribe_url` (subscription product listing, /de-DE/subscribe/{brand}_{model}), and `plp_leasing_url` (leasing product listing, /de-DE/leasing/{brand}_{model}). Use `plp_leasing_url` when linking from a Leasing advisory, `plp_subscribe_url` when linking from subscription content. If `model` is omitted, returns all currently available models for the brand.

model.description: Optional model name (e.g. "Puma", "iX1"). If omitted, returns all available models for the brand.

name: get_internal_link_url
title: Internal Link URLs
